name: APTDC Haritha Hotel Restaurant, Belum Caves
why_it_matters: The AP Tourism (APTDC Haritha) restaurant directly opposite the Belum Caves entrance in Kolimigundla — by every visitor account the only proper restaurant at the site. A regular thali runs about ₹60. Belum Caves is genuinely remote: there is no other restaurant in the vicinity, so this is the meal for anyone spending the day at India's longest cave system.
insider_tip: The in-house kitchen often serves only in the afternoon and the menu is minimal — visit reviews repeatedly advise carrying snacks and water. If you want a fuller meal, plan it for lunch when the kitchen is active.
signature_address: APTDC Haritha Hotel, opposite Belum Caves entrance, Kolimigundla, Kurnool District 518123

name: Belum Caves Gate-Side South Indian Food Joint
area: Outside Belum Caves main gate, Kolimigundla
why_it_matters: A small food joint just outside the Belum Caves main gate that visitor accounts single out for serving genuinely good South Indian food — a useful alternative to the APTDC restaurant, especially in the morning before the cave tour. With nothing else for many kilometres, the two gate-side options effectively are the dining at Belum.
insider_tip: Stick to freshly made idli, dosa and meals. Hours track the cave's footfall — best in the morning and around lunch. Cash; carry small notes for this remote a spot.
signature_address: Outside Belum Caves main gate, Kolimigundla, Kurnool District 518123

name: Belum Caves Entrance Kiosk (snacks and drinks)
signature_dish: Packaged snacks, cold drinks, ice cream
why_it_matters: The kiosk at the Belum Caves entry plaza selling packaged snacks, cold drinks, ice cream and bottled water — the practical re-stock point for a cave visit that gets hot and humid underground. Not a meal stop, but the place to grab water and a cold drink before or after the descent into India's longest cave system.
insider_tip: The caves are notoriously warm and humid inside — buy water here before going down. Carry your own proper food too, since the kiosk only stocks packaged items. Cash.
signature_address: Belum Caves entry plaza, Kolimigundla, Kurnool District 518123
